input.rationale: There is no audit, inspection or usage-verification right against Sparkling anywhere in the Agreement (a search for audit/inspection language returns nothing, and Section 3 imposes only self-executing use restrictions). The only examination right runs in our favour, over the escrowed Codes. No redline required.

input.quote: Garman shall immediately return all fees paid under this Agreement for services
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalties, late-payment interest, early-termination fee or accelerated-fee obligation is payable by Sparkling; Section 11 simply requires payment per the Fee Schedule and Section 17 imposes no exit charge. The refund mechanics in Sections 8 and 17(c) run in our favour.

input.quote: For the acceptance period and for a period of one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and thereafter for as long as the Software is covered by Maintenance Services and is used by Sparkling in accordance with this Agreement, Garman warrants that the Software shall perform in conformance with the Specifications in all material respects.
input.rationale: The 12-month (and maintenance-long) conformance warranty meets our preferred duration and there is no implied-warranty disclaimer, but Section 12 states no remedy (only a best-efforts repair obligation under Section 10(c)) and there is no professional-and-workmanlike warranty for Garman's installation, conversion, training or support services or a no-malicious-code warranty. We added those with a repair/replace-then-refund remedy.

input.quote: (j) This Agreement constitutes the entire Agreement between the parties with respect to its subject matter, and this Agreement supersedes all prior understandings, representations, negotiations and communications between the parties, oral and written.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance covenant, yet Garman installs, converts data, implements and supports on our systems and at our Authorized Locations. We inserted our standard clause in General Matters (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where our data is processed, certificates on request); E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M is the fallback.
